overall: The AG found no violation: the Board's official notice was posted on the Town Hall bulletin board, and website posting is only a courtesy because Montague had not filed an alternative posting method.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post notice of its May 21, 2013 meeting on the Town website, though the bulletin board notice was posted.
allegations.key_passage: Its inability to do so for this particular meeting did not violate the law, as this additional notice location is merely a courtesy, and not the official posting method.
